entries.speaker: Technical Attacks
entries.en: Performing a [clr 2]specific attack[clr 27] on an enemy with a [clr 2]status[n]ailment[clr 27] will make it a [clr 2]Technical Attack[clr 27]. This increases[n]the damage dealt and may knock the enemy down.

entries.speaker: Technical Attacks
entries.en: Various conditions are required to perform a[n][clr 2]Technical Attack[clr 27]. Those conditions will be displayed[n]in the [clr 2]skill list[clr 27] or on [clr 2]your cursor[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Technical Attacks
entries.en: However, if the enemy's affinities are unknown,[n][clr 2]the conditions will not be shown[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Technical Attacks
entries.en: More information will be listed in[n][clr 2]Variations of Technicals[clr 27].
